_comment: Quests. giver: mob template id of the NPC that offers it; turn_in: who takes it back (default giver). requires: quest keys finished first. steps: in order, each one of kill {mob: n}, collect {item: n} (handed over at turn-in) or talk <mob> (with optional say text), plus objective (tracker text). A top-level kill is one kill step. reward: xp, coin (copper), items, choice (pick one at turn-in), faction {id: amount}, title (titles.json id). Placeholder data (docs/CONTENT_EDITOR.md).

wanderer_trouble.name: Wanderer Trouble
wanderer_trouble.greeting: Those robed wanderers keep pestering my customers. Would you thin them out for me?
wanderer_trouble.description: Orin the Trader wants the robed wanderers driven off from his camp.
wanderer_trouble.summary: Defeat 3 Robed Wanderers near Orin's camp.
wanderer_trouble.accept_text: You agree to help Orin with the wanderers.

forge_supplies.name: Supplies for the Forge
forge_supplies.greeting: You handled those wanderers well. I could use a hand getting the forge running again.
forge_supplies.description: Orin needs copper for the camp forge, and the wolves keep scaring off his miners. He also wants word sent to the guard.
forge_supplies.summary: Hunt 2 Ashen Wolves, gather 2 Copper Ore, tell the Thestran Guard, then return to Orin.
forge_supplies.accept_text: You agree to help Orin get the forge running.

steps.objective: Tell the Thestran Guard the road is clear
steps.say: Orin sent you? Good news. Tell him the guard will watch the mine road.

forest_wolves.name: Wolves at the Edge
forest_wolves.greeting: The timber wolves have grown bold. They circle the outpost every night. Thin the pack, would you?
forest_wolves.description: Warden Elara Thornwood wants the timber wolves around the Wildgrowth outpost thinned out.
forest_wolves.summary: Defeat 4 Timber Wolves near the Wildgrowth outpost.
forest_wolves.accept_text: You agree to hunt the timber wolves.

forest_pelts.name: Gifts for the Wardens
forest_pelts.greeting: Bram can make good use of those pelts, and the old thornback by the creek needs to be put down.
forest_pelts.description: Elara asks you to bring wolf pelts, slay the thornback bear and let Bram the merchant know the trade road is safe.
forest_pelts.summary: Gather 3 Wolf Pelts, slay a Thornback Bear, tell Bram Oakhollow, then return to Elara.
forest_pelts.accept_text: You agree to help the wardens.

steps.objective: Tell Bram Oakhollow the road is safe
steps.say: The bear's gone? Then the carts can run again. Thank Elara for me.
